title: Award‑winning Irish dancers to perform at Wells Junior High School - NewsBreak
text:
By Special to Seacoastonline, ,
1 days ago WELLS, Maine — Ogunquit Performing Arts will celebrate St. Patrick’s season with the return of the Stillson School of Irish Dance on Saturday, March 7, at 6:30 p.m. at Wells Junior High School .
The acclaimed troupe, featuring more than a dozen dancers in traditional, brightly colored costumes, is a longtime local favorite known for award‑winning performances at regional and international competitions.
The program will showcase both the fluid soft‑shoe style and the rhythmic hard‑shoe footwork made famous by productions such as "Riverdance" and "Lord of the Dance." At the end of the show, dancers will invite children — and any adults feeling brave — to join them onstage to try a few steps.
The event will be held at 1470 Post Road (Route 1 just south of the Route 109 intersection). Tickets are $5 at the door, with children under 12 admitted free. There are no advance sales. Free parking and refreshments will be available.
This article originally appeared on Portsmouth Herald: Award‑winning Irish dancers to perform at Wells Junior High School
